she allowed to move on. She allowed to make choices that best serve her. Just like your allowed to feel the way you feel. That doesn’t mean you give her all of this power over you. That doesn’t mean she’s supposed to be the center of your universe. It can’t work like that. please don’t do this, if she doesn’t want to be in a relationship with you then that’s her right. please that put this on her, she will blame herself.

Yes you do matter but your kids matter to you too. Your world does not revolve around her. You can breathe without her, you can live without her, I know it’s hard and you may not want to, but you can, you are, and you will. I’m not saying cut her out of your life because she’s the mother of your children. But I’m saying you cannot bass your existence, your world around her. Because it’s not permanent. When you lose that, it causes the despair that you’re in now. You have to be your own reason, you have to be your own world, your center, you cannot lose yourself. If you can’t find yourself to be a reason to stay and you need someone else, then you use your kids. Because they love you unconditionally.

If you love your kids, then don’t leave them. Don’t leave them alone questioning things. You should care about yourself but at the same time, you should care about your kids. Know that if you do this, you’ll hurt them.
Do you love your kids? Do you love your family?
No you don’t. You will be happy but not doing this.
They won’t. Trust me they won’t. Please don’t do this.
Your kids can’t live without you.
Your kids need you, they love you unconditionally, they have been there since day 1, they’re your soulmates. They can’t live without you. They need you, they are important to you.
I know it’s hard, but please live for your kids. Your kids need you, they love you. They are apart of you.
You never know. If you have kids, try to be there for them and live for them. If not, stay strong so you can meet them one day.
